europe_now.title: European aviation security alerts
europe_now.summary: Malicious hoax bomb threats have targeted European airlines and airports for the third time this week, causing dozens of flights to be diverted. Authorities are investigating the coordinated campaign as security measures across the continent remain on high alert.

sources.headline: Europe: Dozens of flights diverted following bomb threats

europe_now.title: Major cyberattack hits French bank
europe_now.summary: A French bank has been hit by a major cyberattack, with online hacking resulting in the theft of approximately $100 million. The incident has prompted an immediate investigation into the breach of the financial institution's security systems.

sources.headline: Cyberattack: French bank says online hacking stole around $100 million
French bank hit by cyberattack, hackers steal $100 million

top_stories.title: French political deadlock and public protests
top_stories.summary: France is facing deepening political deadlock and widespread public unrest as new strikes and protests spread across the country. The government is struggling to prevent violence as unions demand immediate answers and the budget rejection exacerbates the instability.

sources.headline: France faces new protests as government seeks to prevent violence
France holds new strikes and protests as unions demand immediate answers

top_stories.title: EU unity on Ukraine support
top_stories.summary: European leaders are navigating complex diplomatic dynamics as transatlantic discussions on Ukraine continue amidst ongoing conflict. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni has urged the European Union to maintain a unified and coordinated stance in its support for Ukraine.

sources.headline: Meloni urges ‘disorganized’ EU to speak with one voice on Ukraine
